''See also: [[Seishen Daji Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seishen Daji, also known as Prince Daji, is the second prince of the [[Seishen Kingdom]] and the younger brother of [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]]. Described as having a wolf-like appearance and temperament, he was characterized by intense aggression, a craving for combat, and an arrogant personality. As an [[Underlord]], he utilized dual swords and specialized armor that could be reinforced by his father's techniques. Daji was involved in an assassination attempt against [[Akura Mercy]] and [[Akura Pride|Pride]], acting under the recruitment of [[Monarch]] [[Reigan Shen]]. Following this betrayal, he was captured by the [[Akura clan]] and subjected to punishment that left him physically and spiritually altered. After being held in custody, he was eventually returned to his father, [[King Dakata]]. Although he regained a semblance of his former physical self, his personality underwent a profound transformation; the previous wild aggression and [[hunger]] were replaced by a hollow, obedient nature. He now presents himself as a reformed individual who expresses extreme loyalty to the [[Akura clan]], though observers noted that he appeared to be a mere imitation of his deceased brother.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Daji is a lean and strong individual characterized by a sharp face and wild hair. He is also described as a [[construct]] wearing human skin.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the surviving heir to the Seishen royal family, Daji has plotted against the children of a [[Monarch]] and was recruited to assist in an assassination attempt. He is a person who will kill [[Lindon]] and has previously acted as a guard for [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Seishen Daji is the younger brother of [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]] and the son of [[King Dakata]]. He was recruited by [[Monarch]] [[Reigan Shen]] to assist in an assassination attempt against [[Akura Mercy]] and [[Akura Pride|Pride]]. Additionally, Daji is a person who will kill [[Lindon]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|An [[Underlord]], Daji utilizes savage swordsmanship with blades in both hands, a shield from his [[soulspace]], and [[Striker]] attacks or [[binding|bindings]]. His combat repertoire includes firing blue lightning beams from his [[sword]] and utilizing armor with a [[Ruler construct]] that launches [[stone]] missiles.}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Seishen Daji is the younger brother of [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]] and the son of [[King Dakata]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c6">''Underlord'', chapter 6</ref><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c16">''Underlord'', chapter 16</ref> As a newly minted [[Underlord]], he utilizes a savage style of swordsmanship that was noted by his tutors.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c16" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19">''Underlord'', chapter 19</ref> He fights using swords in both hands, though he can also draw a shield and a left-hand [[sword]] from his [[soulspace]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20">''Underlord'', chapter 20</ref> Daji wears armor provided by his father that enforces him without the cost of [[madra]], featuring a [[Ruler construct]] capable of launching [[stone]] missiles.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c19" /> During combat, he can fire a beam of blue lightning from his [[sword]] and employs [[Striker binding|Striker bindings]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> He was even able to act freely while the [[sacred arts]] of [[Mercy]] were sealed.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /> The helmeted warrior was once contained within a squirming black cocoon behind a wall and was carried in an owl.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c20" /><ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c21">''Underlord'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Recruitment by Reigan Shen}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|As the surviving heir to the Seishen royal family, Seishen Daji was recruited by [[Monarch]] [[Reigan Shen]] to assist in an assassination attempt against [[Akura Pride|Pride]] and [[Akura Mercy]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c9">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 9</ref> Following his involvement in the assassination attempt, Daji was imprisoned.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c9" /> His physical state is marked by [[madra channels]] that appear torn and stitched together, as well as [[blood essence]] that is weaker than expected for an [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c9" /> Having once plotted against the children of a [[Monarch]], he is described as a lean, strong individual with a sharp face and wild hair who resembles a [[construct]] wearing human skin.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c9" /> The perception of his father hovers over his soul, and he eventually served as a guard for [[Prince Seishen Kiro|Kiro]].<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c9" /><ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c14">''Threshold: Stories from Cradle'', chapter 14</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Seishen Daji]] was imprisoned for his role in an assassination attempt.<ref name="cradle-13-threshold-c9" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|“Stay away from Daji,” the King said roughly. “He’ll kill you.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“I came to let you know that we’ve captured Seishen Daji.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c2" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“Seishen Daji,” Mercy said, “swear on your soul to tell me the truth.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|“Very well then,” Mercy pronounced. “In the lack of further evidence, this must be nothing more than a personal grudge between Wei Shi Lindon Arelius and Seishen Daji of the Seishen Kingdom.”<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c3" />}}
